limitations: Holdouts are from the same enrollment sessions. Real classroom accuracy remains unmeasured.

methodology.holdout: Every fifth enrollment sample per student excluded from training.
methodology.unknown: Five folds excluding entire student identities from training.
methodology.uploadPipeline: One held-out cropped photo per student and a six-face composed fixture passed through MediaPipe, alignment, descriptors and matching.
methodology.thresholds: Conservative development thresholds evaluated on this cohort; these are not independent classroom test results.
